recommendation: Keep this audit as-is. Future media metadata changes should be made against the active Attachment/DocumentReference surfaces under a separate tracker, not by reintroducing or editing Media.length in core.

Later Published issue FHIR-23567 merged Media into DocumentReference/Attachment for R5, and commit 5c62f91cd81f150be72ad506c876e3cc20bd631d removed media=Media from fhir.ini. The active Attachment datatype contains Attachment.duration with duration wording.
